landing.title: Track your Quran memorization with care
landing.subtitle: Quality-based spaced repetition across Juz, Surah, and Page. Homework sessions, progress charts, and per-page reviews — all in one calm space.
landing.tryGuest: Try it now — no sign up
landing.guestNote: Guest mode saves your progress on this device. Sign up any time to keep it across devices — your guest data carries over automatically.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three simple loops keep your hifz alive — without spreadsheets, without nagging.

mark.title: 1. Mark as you recite
mark.body: Tap an ayah on the Reader to flag a mistake, link a tricky transition, or confirm a clean pass.

schedule.title: 2. We schedule the next review
schedule.body: Each page picks up an Excellent / Good / Hard / Relearn rating that maps to a personal day-buffer in your Settings.

review.title: 3. Come back when it's due
review.body: Your Dashboard surfaces what's due today, what's slipping, and your daily Telawa rotation across all 604 pages.

reader.title: A focused Mushaf with one-tap marking
reader.body: Read full Mushaf pages in the same script you memorize from. Tap any ayah to mark a mistake, a link, or a clear pass — every mark is stored per-page so you can revisit and clean up later.

bullets.0: Mistake / Link / Clear marks compose visually so you see exactly what tripped you
bullets.1: Resizable text saved to your settings, so the page looks the same on every device
bullets.2: One button to clear every mark on the current page when you want a fresh start

dashboard.title: See where you stand at a glance
dashboard.body: Total memorized pages, what's due today, your active streak, and a single progress bar across the whole Mushaf — every time you open the app.

bullets.0: Live counts for memorized, due, and at-risk pages
bullets.1: Per-Juz progress so you always know what's next
bullets.2: Streak tracking that respects guest mode and signed-in accounts equally

ayahs.title: Browse and search every single ayah
ayahs.body: All 6,236 ayahs in one searchable grid. Diacritic-insensitive Arabic search, surah / juz / page filters, and a focused single-ayah view with the same marks the Reader uses.

bullets.0: Search ignores tashkeel — type 'الرحمن' or 'الرحمٰن' and both match
bullets.1: Detail view jumps straight back to the Reader with the practice ayah pre-selected
bullets.2: Per-ayah font size that's saved to your settings for study sessions

mistakes.title: Every slip becomes a study list
mistakes.body: Marks made in any view stream into a single Mistakes feed, sorted so the freshest pain points stay at the top. Open one to drill the exact ayah in the Reader.

bullets.0: One unified feed across Reader, Ayahs, and Pages
bullets.1: Filter by mistake vs link to focus your session
bullets.2: Resolve a mark and it disappears from the feed automatically

telawa.title: Daily rotation across the whole Mushaf
telawa.body: Set a daily page goal and the app rotates through all 604 pages so the parts you don't actively review still get visited. Recite, tap done, move on.

bullets.1: Rolling history so you can see the last week at a glance
bullets.2: Independent of memorization status — every page gets revisited

pages.title: Every page, every status, every due date
pages.body: The full Mushaf as a list. See the quality of your last review, when it's next due, and jump straight into the page to recite or re-rate.

bullets.0: Status pills colour-coded by quality (Excellent → Relearn)
bullets.1: Sorted by next-due date so urgent reviews surface first
bullets.2: Filter by Juz, Surah, or status to narrow your session

bilingual.title: Built for Arabic and English, side by side
bilingual.body: The whole UI flips to RTL when you switch to Arabic — including the Mushaf controls, search, and filters. Pick whichever feels natural; switch any time.

cta.title: Start your hifz tracker today
cta.body: No setup, no spreadsheets. Try it as a guest — your progress saves on this device and carries over the moment you create an account.

autoAssign.title: Auto-record page recitations
autoAssign.description: When every ayah on a page has been marked today (cleared or with mistakes), automatically record a recitation for the whole page. The quality is computed from the day's total mistakes using the thresholds below. A new recitation is only logged when the resulting quality differs from any recitation already recorded today for the same page.
autoAssign.label: Auto-record from ayah marks

autoExpire.title: Auto-expire ayah marks
autoExpire.description: When enabled, per-ayah marks (cleared, mistakes, and link issues) that are older than 14 days are automatically hidden from the Reader and Ayah detail screens. The marks are kept in the database for history — only the live display is affected. Page recitation status is never changed.
autoExpire.label: Hide marks older than 2 weeks

duePagesSectionCollapsed.title: Pages requiring attention — default view
duePagesSectionCollapsed.description: When enabled, the surah groups on the Dashboard start collapsed. Tap a surah header to expand and review its pages. Disable to start with all groups expanded (original behavior).
duePagesSectionCollapsed.label: Start collapsed by default

homeworkReadGoal.label: Homework weekly read goal
homeworkReadGoal.description: How many times to read or recite each active homework page per week. Either reading or reciting counts.

mistakeThresholds.title: Mistake thresholds
mistakeThresholds.description: How many total page mistakes map to each quality. Excellent is always 0 mistakes. Anything above the Hard threshold is recorded as Relearn.
mistakeThresholds.hardBelowGood: Hard threshold must be at least the Good threshold.
